q1.explanationZh: cook 作名词是“厨师”，作动词是“烹调”；注意 cooker 是“炊具”，不是厨师。

q2.explanationZh: cook 加 -er 不表示人，cooker 是“炊具”；厨师是 cook。

q3.explanationZh: cookie“曲奇饼”，口语里也指“人”，a tough cookie“意志坚强的人”。

q4.explanationZh: cool 形容词“凉快的；冷静的”，口语里表示“酷，绝妙的”。

q5.explanationZh: cooperate 不及物动词“合作”，cooperate with sb.；名词 cooperation。

q6.explanationZh: cope 不及物动词，常用 cope with“应付，处理”。

q7.explanationZh: copy 作动词“抄写；复印”，作名词“复印件；副本”，第三人称单数 copies。

q8.explanationZh: core 名词“核心”，也可作形容词，如 core values“核心价值”。

q9.explanationZh: corn“谷物；玉米”，注意与 corner“角”区分。

q10.explanationZh: corner 名词“角；街角”，动词“将……逼入困境”。

q11.explanationZh: corporate 是形容词“公司的；法人的”，名词是 corporation。

q12.explanationZh: corporate 的名词 corporation“公司；法人团体”。

q13.explanationZh: correct 动词“改正”，形容词“正确的”，反义词 incorrect。

q14.explanationZh: correspond 不及物动词“相符合”，常用 correspond to/with。

q15.explanationZh: corridor“走廊”，注意双写 r，结尾是 -or。

q16.explanationZh: cosmetic 形容词“化妆用的”；作名词“化妆品”时常用复数 cosmetics。

q17.explanationZh: cost 的过去式、过去分词都是 cost；主语通常是物：sth. cost sb. some money。

q18.explanationZh: costume“（特定场合或时期的）服装；戏装”，注意与 custom“习俗”区分。

q19.explanationZh: cottage“小屋；村舍”，双写 t，结尾 -age。

q21.explanationZh: couch“长沙发”，couch potato“整天看电视的人”。

q22.explanationZh: cough 既是动词也是名词“咳嗽”，-ough 读 /ɒf/。

q23.explanationZh: could 是情态动词 can 的过去式，也可用于虚拟语气或表示委婉、可能。

q24.explanationZh: council“委员会；理事会”，注意与 counsel“劝告”区分。

q25.explanationZh: count“数，计算”，count on“指望”，派生词 countless“数不尽的”。

q26.explanationZh: counter“柜台”，at the counter“在柜台前”。

q27.explanationZh: country“国家”；表示“乡下”时常用 the country。

q28.explanationZh: country + side 构成 countryside“农村地区”，常与 the 连用。

q29.explanationZh: county“郡；县”，注意与 country“国家”只差一个 r。

q30.explanationZh: couple 名词“一对；夫妻”，动词“连接”；a couple of“几个”。

q31.explanationZh: courage“勇气”，形容词 courageous，动词 encourage“鼓励”。

q32.explanationZh: course“过程；课程”，of course“当然”，in the course of“在……过程中”。

q33.explanationZh: court“球场；法庭”，如 basketball court“篮球场”。

q34.explanationZh: cousin 指堂（表）兄弟姐妹，不分男女。

q35.explanationZh: cover 名词“封面；盖子”，动词“覆盖；行过（路程）；包括”。

q36.explanationZh: cover 加 -age 构成名词 coverage“覆盖范围；新闻报道”。

q38.explanationZh: crack 名词“裂缝”，动词“（使）裂开”。

q39.explanationZh: “和某人合作”= cooperate with sb.，cooperate 是不及物动词，后面要加 with。

q40.explanationZh: cope 是不及物动词，“应付，处理”要说 cope with。

q41.explanationZh: around the corner“就在拐角处”，也比喻“即将到来，非常近”。

q42.explanationZh: “在拐角处”= at the corner = on the corner，指在外部的拐角。

q43.explanationZh: be in a tight corner“陷入困境”，tight 表示“紧的，困难的”。

q44.explanationZh: drive sb. into a corner“把某人逼入困境”，介词用 into。

q45.explanationZh: in the corner 指房间等内部的角落；外部的拐角用 at/on the corner。

q46.explanationZh: at all costs“不惜任何代价”，costs 用复数。

q47.explanationZh: at the cost of“以……为代价”，cost 用单数，前面用 the。

accept: count on sb. to do sth.

q48.explanationZh: count on sb. (for sth.)“指望某人（提供某物）”，count on sb. to do sth.“指望某人做某事”。

q49.explanationZh: a couple of“一对，几个”，后接可数名词复数。

q50.explanationZh: in the course of“在……过程中；在……期间”。

q51.explanationZh: food court“美食街”，court 在这里指“（集中的）区域”。

q53.explanationZh: cover A with B“用 B 覆盖 A”；被动 be covered with“被……覆盖”。

q54.explanationZh: settle out of court“庭外和解”，court 指“法庭”，out of court 中不加冠词。

q55.explanationZh: a large ... chemical 后需要可数名词单数，“一家大型化学公司”用 corporation。

q56.explanationZh: cover 可表示“行过（一段路程）”，to 后接动词原形 cover。

q57.explanationZh: 与 break“打破”对比，“打裂”用 crack，情态动词 can 后接原形。

q58.explanationZh: count on sb. for sth.“指望某人提供……”，can 后接动词原形 count。

q59.explanationZh: 祈使句用动词原形，correct mistakes“改正错误”。

q60.explanationZh: 售货员靠在“柜台”上，lean on a counter；a 后接名词单数。

q61.explanationZh: be poor at doing sth.“不擅长做某事”，介词 at 后用动名词 cooking。

q62.explanationZh: cooperate with each other“互相合作”，can 后接动词原形。

q63.explanationZh: the high cost“高成本”，high 修饰名词 cost。

q64.sampleAnswer: What makes him a household name as a sports star is not only his excellent performance on the court, but also his hard work and modesty.
references: What makes him a household name as a sports star is not only his excellent performance on the court, but also his hard work and modesty.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “他之所以……的原因”可用主语从句 What makes him...；“家喻户晓的人”= a household name；“在赛场上”= on the court；“不仅……而且……”= not only... but also...。

q65.sampleAnswer: The airport is trying to cope with the flights held up by the heavy fog.
references: The airport is trying to cope with the flights held up by the heavy fog.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “处理，应付”= cope with；“被延误的航班”用过去分词短语作后置定语 held up by...；“大雾”= heavy fog。

q66.sampleAnswer: There is no point in counting on him because he is helpless too.
references: There is no point in counting on him because he is helpless too.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “做某事毫无意义”= There is no point in doing sth.，介词 in 后用动名词 counting on；“束手无策”= helpless。

q67.sampleAnswer: Teachers should provide students with chances to cooperate so that they can learn how to communicate with others.
references: Teachers should provide students with chances to cooperate so that they can learn how to communicate with others.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “为某人提供某物”= provide sb. with sth.；“合作的机会”= chances to cooperate；“以便”= so that。

q68.sampleAnswer: Online payment brings convenience to consumers at the cost of their privacy.
references: Online payment brings convenience to consumers at the cost of their privacy.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “以……为代价，牺牲……”= at the cost of；“给某人带来方便”= bring convenience to sb.。

q69.sampleAnswer: My cousin is always ready to help others, and she often serves as a volunteer in an orphanage.
references: My cousin is always ready to help others, and she often serves as a volunteer in an orphanage.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “表姐”= cousin；“乐于做某事”= be ready to do sth.；“做志愿者”= serve as a volunteer；“孤儿院”= orphanage。

q70.sampleAnswer: It was the astronauts’ spirit of our country that enabled us to overcome all the difficulties.
references: It was the astronauts’ spirit of our country that enabled us to overcome all the difficulties.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “正是……才……”用强调句 It was... that...；“使某人能够做某事”= enable sb. to do sth.；“克服”= overcome。

q71.sampleAnswer: He keeps cycling in such cold weather that I can’t help but admire his courage and perseverance.
references: He keeps cycling in such cold weather that I can’t help but admire his courage and perseverance.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q71.explanationZh: “如此……以至于”= such... that...；“坚持做某事”= keep doing sth.；“不得不”= can’t help but do；“勇气和毅力”= courage and perseverance。

q72.sampleAnswer: In the course of the economic development, we must pay attention to keeping the balance of nature.
references: In the course of the economic development, we must pay attention to keeping the balance of nature.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q72.explanationZh: “在……过程中”= in the course of；“注意”= pay attention to，to 是介词，后接动名词 keeping。

q73.sampleAnswer: Make a habit of watching weather forecast every day, so that you can cope with the unpredictable and changeable weather in Shanghai.
references: Make a habit of watching weather forecast every day, so that you can cope with the unpredictable and changeable weather in Shanghai.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q73.explanationZh: “养成……的习惯”= make a habit of doing sth.；“应付”= cope with；“变幻莫测的”= unpredictable，“变化多端的”= changeable。
